title: Time-Inconsistent Preferences and Strategic Self-Control in Digital Content Consumption
authors: Shuo Zhang; Tat Y. Chan; Xueming Luo; Xiaoyi Wang
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Dynamic structural model of time-inconsistent preferences and strategic plan choice in digital reading, estimated by maximum likelihood with latent segments.
design_notes: replication file.R: simulation_model() generates data for 11,346 consumers in two segments from true parameters and recovers them (ll_main_sim, se_estimition); Read me file.docx describes this identification exercise.
data_files_note: Only a simulation-and-recovery script; no data file.
data_provenance_note: Real data not shipped; the script simulates data from assumed parameters.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
